periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical-ovoid, with the height-to-width ratio significantly greater than 1.0.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering toward the muzzle; the lowest point is significantly distal to the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal-torso longitudinal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the superior cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly convex and uniformly rounded curvature at the superior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced chromatic shift between the bright white cephalic fur and the yellowish-beige pigmentation of the posterior dorsal fur.
